title: Pricing & Passes | Zumba with B
lines: Join high-energy Zumba sessions in Paris designed to keep you moving, sweating, and smiling. Choose between single drop-in passes or flexible monthly packages, and enjoy complete transparency with no hidden fees.
Book online via PayPal, pay on our website, or pay cash directly at the door before session start. Your first class is 100% free when you subscribe to our mailing list.
Sign up for our newsletter to claim your free first class or reserve your spot today. Discover our full weekly timetable and see what to expect in every session.
